name: RAFTAR
description: A browser speed test with an instrument-style dashboard for download speed, upload speed, and latency.
features: Analog and digital gauges · configurable appearance · connection measurements

name: ZARB
description: Tap along with a rhythm to estimate its tempo. Follow BPM, the running average, and the range of your taps through a customizable gauge.
features: Tap tempo · session log · minimum and maximum BPM
note: A tap-tempo tool; it does not analyze uploaded audio.

name: Boundary & State Lab
description: Explore time-series boundaries and states through an interactive SegStream workspace with embedded datasets and saved analysis.
features: Signal inspection · window comparisons · boundary and state exploration
note: Includes the bundled research data. Initial loading may take a moment.

name: NET Practice Simulator
description: Practice Mathematics, Physics, and English with a configurable exam, timed sections, worked explanations, and topic-level results.
features: Five difficulty levels · saved attempts · grading and review · exports
note: Practice material. Internet is needed to load the mathematics renderer.

name: Urdu Word Cloud
description: An evolving composition of Urdu expressions, shaped by script, scale, and color. Explore a different side of my work through typography.
features: Urdu font choices · six color palettes · animated word layout

name: Enterprise Workspace
description: A browser-based operations workspace connecting tasks, people, planning, approvals, and reporting in one interface.
features: Task workflows · monthly planning · audit log · theme customization
note: Interactive prototype with demonstration records stored in your browser.

name: Cantt Events
description: An events-management prototype combining hall bookings, a fleet map, alerts, and operational reports.
features: Booking calendar · simulated fleet tracking · map themes · PDF reports
note: Demonstration fleet data. Maps and chart libraries require internet.

name: Tilt Scale
description: Explore the relationship between tilt and balance using a phone’s motion sensor, a simple beam, and a known calibration weight.
features: Guided setup · zeroing · calibration · saved readings
note: Best on a compatible phone over HTTPS; requires sensor permission and a physical setup.
